Incumbent [[Republican Party (United States)|Republican]] Governor [[Henry McMaster]], who took office after [[Nikki Haley]] resigned to become [[U.S. Ambassador to the United Nations]], ran for election to a full term. The primary was held on June 12, with the Democrats nominating State Representative [[James E. Smith Jr.]] McMaster failed to win a majority of the vote, and then defeated John Warren in the Republican runoff on June 26.
